sources.role: Track A primary benchmark (validation = development, test = frozen holdout)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; local non-commercial research/evaluation only; no raw redistribution
sources.label_creator: USPTO examiners via office actions, compiled by the dataset authors
sources.label_semantics: gold = documents cited to reject that claim; silver = other documents cited in the examination; negatives = remaining options
sources.label_type: documented citation proxy; incomplete; not exhaustive relevance
sources.circularity_risk: PatEmbed (PatenTEB multi-task) may have trained on USPTO citation-derived tasks; not ruled out
sources.eligibility: ELIGIBLE for the Track A claims as worded in the claims-evidence matrix
sources.prior_exposure: per-row BM25 baseline previously run on both splits; no new method scored on test before freeze ff603bb

sources.label_semantics: paragraph cited by examiner within a prior-art document

sources.role: external relevance diagnostic (historical lexical diagnostic only)
sources.label_creator: patent-domain human annotators (Helmers et al., 2019 PLOS ONE dataset)
sources.label_semantics: binary human relevance for selected target/candidate pairs (10 targets, 450 judged pairs)
sources.eligibility: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: selected pool, no official split, 10 targets too few for confirmatory inference

sources.source: openFDA PMA records + public company product-patent disclosure pages + public US patent pages (results/healthtech/ht-public-cohort-20261028-r1 and later company cohorts)
sources.label_semantics: documented product-level device-patent relationships; unlisted pairs are unjudged, not negative
sources.label_type: documented association proxy; incomplete; not semantic relevance
sources.eligibility: DEVELOPMENT_AND_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: too few independent groups; Stryker view previously exposed
BLOCKED_LOCAL: rights clause missing, 672 vs 585 pair reconciliation unresolved, train/eval positive overlap

sources.role: engineering canary and literal source-fidelity check
sources.source: openFDA PMA records P100009, P240042, P230007 (openFDA-last-updated-2026-10-19)
sources.label_semantics: authoritative structured fields (pma_number, trade_name, applicant); deterministic literal check
sources.eligibility: ENGINEERING_ONLY: 3 cases, 9 fields, no patent content
COMPONENT_ONLY: not pooled with patent results

solo_assessment: No human assessor was used. No LLM judgment is used as a label.
